seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Player A1-4: turn cap + move 4px unless wall bbox/box/chaser/bounds block; grabbed box moves rigidly (may enter wall).
Box states idle/faced/grabbed/carried by border colour (4/3/0/5); idle box in front of cap -> faced, A5 faced<->grabbed, faced box left behind -> idle; seated/filled tags positional; boxes renamed by (y,x).
Chaser acts every call: release seated carried box > grab idle unseated box at its left > step 4 x-first (y if blocked) toward nearest pickup point (box.x+4,box.y) or nearest empty slot when carrying.
Wall pixels = period-4 texture recovered per row%4, -1 under layer>0 objects.
Hidden-state hypothesis not needed (passes stateless); unconfirmed: pulling a grabbed box, cap_down pixels, chaser tie-breaks.
